The Sunnah and Education The Sunnah and Education Thave studied the issue of knowledge, learning and teaching in the light of the Sunnah"), j., through the two main ‘ions of the Aadiths of the Prophet Muhammad (Peace be upon him): The Sound Hadith (Hadith Sahih)” and the Good Hadith (Hadith Hasan).°) This study came out in my book The Prophet and Knowledge, and 1 could see how the Prophet (Peace be upon him) - even though being illiterate - cared about knowledge and praised scholars. He even set basics for the morals that should control the behavior of scholars and guide them through (the process of teaching). This study also shows how the Sunnah was way ahead in establishing the best rules and the greatest educational values that many people - even among the Muslims - still believe they are an outcome of modern contemporary studies that no body came to know but the West.
